title: Collapse LTX to ONE card: dev int8 + distill LoRA as a turbo toggle
description: Replace the LTX card PAIR (High distilled-1.1 bf16 41GB + Balanced fp8 25.2 / mxfp8 24.1, arch-split) with ONE card: ltx-2.3-22b-dev_transformer_only_int8_convrot 21.5GB plus the rank-111 distill LoRA 2.74GB, toggled at runtime. Exactly the Krea 2 pattern (capabilities.turboToggle + Input_is_Turbo + an MpiMath-gated accelerator LoRA), which already retired ITS separate Turbo card. LoRA off = dev quality, LoRA on = distilled speed. ~66GB of card-pair becomes one 24.25GB install, and the variants.arch axis may disappear with it.
acceptance: PROVE FIRST: a bf16 rank-111 LoRA patches cleanly onto int8 weights and quality holds - turbo mode IS that, so a failure here kills the whole plan
int8 runs on a NON-Blackwell card (Ada/Ampere), or the variants.arch block stays
dev mode gets its own steps/CFG/sigma tune - the LTXVScheduler + split-sigma + stage-2 0.85 numbers were all measured on distilled
The three baked LoRAs (merged 3.87GB, transition, talkvid) still behave on a dev base - they were tuned against distilled
One ModelDef with capabilities.turboToggle; ltx-23 and ltx-23-balanced both retired
Both weights uploaded to R2 - our LTX deps serve from models.cubric.studio with HF as mirrorUrl
